name: automatic-entity-measurements
goal: Show automatically collected source metrics and recorded performance without confusing missing evidence with test failures

evidence: At de0774e the helper page has no attached record, source metrics or benchmark. Expected: commit-derived static metrics, recorded benchmark observations without budgets, and distinct missing/failure indicators.

History indexing tested records but not unverified source metrics. Measurement UI only tested budgeted workloads. Verdict tests required red for every unknown state. Strengthen these standard suites and loop recording capture retention.

The committed standard coverage failed on missing source metrics, discarded benchmark captures, budget-only display and red missing-evidence icons. Record 34b7c053 proves the frozen corpus at 68bb50cc.

Read source metrics from exact Git trees; preserve benchmark observations in focused proofs; show observations without a budget and only the selected callable; distinguish missing coverage from failed checks.

Unchanged frozen standard tests passed at b5dd8821, including source metrics without records, benchmark retention, budget-free display and responsive checkpoints. Eight real casing-helper benchmark measurements were retained in Git-backed focused proof.
